TaskDescription: 'No Heights' baseline: 5 min in the virtual hospital room without the heights stimulus, measured before the heights stimulus (Yilmaz Balban et al. 2021 Curr Biol 31:601-612.e3, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2020.11.035, STAR Methods, Modified Heights Stimulus); release: "TDTData_baseline: raw iEEG signal from all channels during the no heights condition"
InstitutionName: University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) Hospital
ManufacturersModelName: PZ2 (256-channel) or PZ5 (512-channel) amplifier with RZ2 digital acquisition system
iEEGReference: Not documented in the release (TDT raw export).
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically determined implant for seizure localization; depth electrodes per the electrode table of the release
iEEGElectrodeGroups: Electrode leads of the release electrode table: OFC1 (depth, 10 contacts), OFC2 (depth, 10 contacts), OFC3 (depth, 10 contacts), CIN (depth, 10 contacts), SMG (depth, 10 contacts). The mapping of TDT inputs (ch001..) to these leads is not documented in the release.
SourceFile: iEEG data/EC 205/TDTData_B10_baselineinVR.mat (variable Data); TDT block B10
iEEGGround: n/a (not documented in the paper or the release)
